segments.t: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,
segments.note: 「Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking」Ἀποθέμενοι οὖν πᾶσαν κακίαν καὶ πάντα δόλον καὶ ὑποκρίσεις καὶ φθόνους καὶ πάσας καταλαλιάς。「evil speaking」は καταλαλιάς のほぐし

segments.t: as newborn babies,
segments.note: 「as newborn babies」ὡς ἀρτιγέννητα βρέφη

segments.t: long for the pure spiritual milk,
segments.note: 「long for the pure spiritual milk」ἐπιποθήσατε τὸ λογικὸν ἄδολον γάλα

segments.t: that with it you may grow,
segments.note: 「that with it you may grow」ἵνα ἐν αὐτῷ αὐξηθῆτε。εἰς σωτηρίαν（13–14番）は WEB 本文に訳出されない

segments.t: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
segments.note: 「if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious」εἰ ἐγεύσασθε ὅτι χρηστὸς ὁ κύριος

segments.t: Come to him, a living stone,
segments.note: 「Come to him, a living stone」Πρὸς ὃν προσερχόμενοι λίθον ζῶντα

segments.t: rejected indeed by men,
segments.note: 「rejected indeed by men」ἀποδεδοκιμασμένον ὑπὸ ἀνθρώπων μὲν

segments.t: but chosen by God, precious.
segments.note: 「but chosen by God, precious」ἐκλεκτὸν παρὰ δὲ θεῷ ἔντιμον。WEB の語順はほぐし

segments.t: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house,
segments.note: 「You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house」καὶ αὐτοὶ ὡς λίθοι ζῶντες οἰκοδομεῖσθε οἶκος πνευματικός

segments.t: to be a holy priesthood,
segments.note: 「to be a holy priesthood」εἰς ἱεράτευμα ἅγιον

segments.t: to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
segments.note: 「to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ」ἀνενέγκαι πνευματικὰς θυσίας εὐπροσδέκτους θεῷ διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ

segments.t: Because it is contained in Scripture,
segments.note: 「Because it is contained in Scripture」διότι περιέχει ἐν γραφῇ

segments.t: “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious.
segments.note: 「Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious」Ἰδοὺ τίθημι ἐν Σιὼν λίθον ἀκρογωνιαῖον ἐκλεκτὸν ἔντιμον

segments.t: He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”
segments.note: 「He who believes in him will not be disappointed」καὶ ὁ πιστεύων ἐπ’ αὐτῷ οὐ μὴ καταισχυνθῇ

segments.t: For you who believe therefore is the honor,
segments.note: 「For you who believe therefore is the honor」ὑμῖν οὖν ἡ τιμὴ τοῖς πιστεύουσιν

segments.t: but for those who are disobedient,
segments.note: 「but for those who are disobedient」δὲ ἀπιστοῦσιν。WEB の「disobedient」はビザンティン本文 ἀπειθοῦσιν に対応する。ギリシャ語本文は ἀπιστοῦσιν（信じない者）

segments.t: “The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone,”
segments.note: 「The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone」λίθος ὃν ἀπεδοκίμασαν οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες οὗτος ἐγενήθη εἰς κεφαλὴν γωνίας

segments.t: and, “a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.”
segments.note: 「and, “a stumbling stone and a rock of offense”」καὶ λίθος προσκόμματος καὶ πέτρα σκανδάλου

segments.t: For they stumble at the word, being disobedient,
segments.note: 「For they stumble at the word, being disobedient」οἳ προσκόπτουσιν τῷ λόγῳ ἀπειθοῦντες。「For」は英語の補い

segments.t: to which also they were appointed.
segments.note: 「to which also they were appointed」εἰς ὃ καὶ ἐτέθησαν

segments.t: But you are a chosen race,
segments.note: 「But you are a chosen race」Ὑμεῖς δὲ γένος ἐκλεκτόν

segments.t: a royal priesthood,
a holy nation,
a people for God’s own possession,
segments.note: 「a people for God’s own possession」λαὸς εἰς περιποίησιν。「God’s」は英語の補い

segments.t: that you may proclaim the excellence
segments.note: 「that you may proclaim the excellence」ὅπως τὰς ἀρετὰς ἐξαγγείλητε

segments.t: of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
segments.note: 「of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light」τοῦ ἐκ σκότους ὑμᾶς καλέσαντος εἰς τὸ θαυμαστὸν αὐτοῦ φῶς

segments.t: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people,
segments.note: 「In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people」οἵ ποτε οὐ λαὸς νῦν δὲ λαὸς θεοῦ。WEB の語順はほぐし

segments.t: who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
segments.note: 「who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy」οἱ οὐκ ἠλεημένοι νῦν δὲ ἐλεηθέντες

segments.t: Beloved, I beg you
segments.note: 「Beloved, I beg you」Ἀγαπητοί παρακαλῶ

segments.t: as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain
segments.note: 「as foreigners and pilgrims」ὡς παροίκους καὶ παρεπιδήμους

segments.t: from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,
segments.note: 「to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul」ἀπέχεσθαι τῶν σαρκικῶν ἐπιθυμιῶν αἵτινες στρατεύονται κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς

segments.t: having good behavior among the nations,
segments.note: 「having good behavior among the nations」τὴν ἀναστροφὴν ὑμῶν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἔχοντες καλήν。WEB の語順はほぐし

segments.t: so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers,
segments.note: 「so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers」ἵνα ἐν ᾧ καταλαλοῦσιν ὑμῶν ὡς κακοποιῶν

segments.t: they may see your good works
segments.note: 「they may see your good works」ἐποπτεύοντες ἐκ τῶν καλῶν ἔργων。WEB は「see」を前に出す

segments.t: and glorify God in the day of visitation.
segments.note: 「and glorify God in the day of visitation」δοξάσωσι τὸν θεὸν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπισκοπῆς

segments.t: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake:
segments.note: 「Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man」Ὑποτάγητε πάσῃ ἀνθρωπίνῃ κτίσει。「Therefore」はビザンティン本文の οὖν に対応する。κτίσει は WEB で「ordinance」と訳される

segments.t: whether to the king, as supreme,
segments.note: 「for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme」διὰ τὸν κύριον εἴτε βασιλεῖ ὡς ὑπερέχοντι

segments.t: or to governors, as sent by him
segments.note: 「or to governors, as sent by him」εἴτε ἡγεμόσιν ὡς δι’ αὐτοῦ πεμπομένοις

segments.t: for vengeance on evildoers
segments.note: 「for vengeance on evildoers」εἰς ἐκδίκησιν κακοποιῶν

segments.t: and for praise to those who do well.
segments.note: 「and for praise to those who do well」ἔπαινον δὲ ἀγαθοποιῶν

segments.t: For this is the will of God,
segments.note: 「For this is the will of God」ὅτι οὕτως ἐστὶν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ

segments.t: that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.
segments.note: 「that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men」ἀγαθοποιοῦντας φιμοῦν τὴν τῶν ἀφρόνων ἀνθρώπων ἀγνωσίαν

segments.t: Live as free people,
segments.note: 「Live as free people」ὡς ἐλεύθεροι。「Live」は英語の補い

segments.t: yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness,
segments.note: 「yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness」καὶ μὴ ὡς ἐπικάλυμμα ἔχοντες τῆς κακίας τὴν ἐλευθερίαν

segments.t: but as bondservants of God.
segments.note: 「but as bondservants of God」ἀλλ’ ὡς θεοῦ δοῦλοι

segments.t: Honor all men.
Love the brotherhood.
Fear God.
Honor the king.
Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect,
segments.note: 「Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect」Οἱ οἰκέται ὑποτασσόμενοι ἐν παντὶ φόβῳ τοῖς δεσπόταις。「your」は英語の補い

segments.t: not only to the good and gentle,
segments.note: 「not only to the good and gentle」οὐ μόνον τοῖς ἀγαθοῖς καὶ ἐπιεικέσιν

segments.t: but also to the wicked.
segments.note: 「but also to the wicked」ἀλλὰ καὶ τοῖς σκολιοῖς

segments.t: For it is commendable
segments.note: 「For it is commendable」γὰρ τοῦτο χάρις。「commendable」は χάρις の表現

segments.t: if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.
segments.note: 「if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God」εἰ διὰ συνείδησιν θεοῦ ὑποφέρει τις λύπας πάσχων ἀδίκως。WEB の語順はほぐし

segments.t: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating?
segments.note: 「For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating?」ποῖον γὰρ κλέος εἰ ἁμαρτάνοντες καὶ κολαφιζόμενοι ὑπομενεῖτε

segments.t: But if when you do well, you patiently endure suffering,
segments.note: 「But if when you do well, you patiently endure suffering」ἀλλ’ εἰ ἀγαθοποιοῦντες καὶ πάσχοντες ὑπομενεῖτε

segments.t: this is commendable with God.
segments.note: 「this is commendable with God」τοῦτο χάρις παρὰ θεῷ

segments.t: For you were called to this,
segments.note: 「For you were called to this」εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ ἐκλήθητε

segments.t: because Christ also suffered for us,
segments.note: 「because Christ also suffered for us」ὅτι καὶ Χριστὸς ἔπαθεν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν。WEB の「for us」はビザンティン本文 ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν に対応する。ギリシャ語本文は ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν（あなたがたのために）

segments.t: leaving you an example,
segments.note: 「leaving you an example」ὑμῖν ὑπολιμπάνων ὑπογραμμὸν

segments.t: that you should follow his steps,
segments.note: 「that you should follow his steps」ἵνα ἐπακολουθήσητε τοῖς ἴχνεσιν αὐτοῦ

segments.t: who didn’t sin,
segments.note: 「who didn’t sin」ὃς ἁμαρτίαν οὐκ ἐποίησεν

segments.t: “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”
segments.note: 「“neither was deceit found in his mouth”」οὐδὲ εὑρέθη δόλος ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτοῦ

segments.t: When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back.
segments.note: 「When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back」ὃς λοιδορούμενος οὐκ ἀντελοιδόρει

segments.t: When he suffered, he didn’t threaten,
segments.note: 「When he suffered, he didn’t threaten」πάσχων οὐκ ἠπείλει

segments.t: but committed himself to him who judges righteously.
segments.note: 「but committed himself to him who judges righteously」παρεδίδου δὲ τῷ κρίνοντι δικαίως。「himself」は英語の補い

segments.t: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree,
segments.note: 「He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree」ὃς τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἡμῶν αὐτὸς ἀνήνεγκεν ἐν τῷ σώματι αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸ ξύλον。WEB の語順はほぐし

segments.t: that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness.
segments.note: 「that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness」ἵνα ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ἀπογενόμενοι τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ ζήσωμεν

segments.t: You were healed by his wounds.
segments.note: 「You were healed by his wounds」οὗ τῷ μώλωπι ἰάθητε

segments.t: For you were going astray like sheep;
segments.note: 「For you were going astray like sheep」ἦτε γὰρ ὡς πρόβατα πλανώμενοι

segments.t: but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
segments.note: 「but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls」ἀλλὰ ἐπεστράφητε νῦν ἐπὶ τὸν ποιμένα καὶ ἐπίσκοπον τῶν ψυχῶν ὑμῶν
